editionLabel: Ravensburger Dutch rulebook, file 27029; English summary
firstPlayerRule: Whoever was most recently hissed at by a cat starts. Continue clockwise after each player's turn.
officialTieBreak: Otherwise, the oldest player starts, as the rulebook instructs.
clarifications: Each turn consists of the Crew Action phase followed by the Encounter phase.
interpretation: This is an English summary of the cited Dutch rulebook.
